'''Chris Klint''' won the [[1998 Juneau tournament]], a sanctioned Swiss event in Juneau, Alaska, on 1 March 1998.<ref name="list-35938">[http://www.egroups.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/35938.html? swccg-discussion message #35938], [[Chris Klint]] (1 March 1998).
